senses.gloss: (b. h. שָׂבַרPi.; Saf. of ברר) [to be bright,] to look for, be hopeful; to think, imagine. Part. pass. סָבוּר; f. סְבוּרָה; pl. סְבוּרִים, סְבוּרִין; סְבוּרוֹת hoping; thinking.
units: <cite ref="Ruth Rabbah, Petichta 1">Ruth R. to I, 1</cite> <he>היו … ס׳ עליו</he> the citizens were relying on him; (Yalk. ib. 598 <he>בטוחין</he>).—
<cite ref="Mishnah Ketubot 7:10">Keth. VII, 10</cite> <he>ס׳ הייתי וכ׳</he> I was in hopes that I might be able to bear it.

<cite ref="Gittin 56b:9">Gitt. 56ᵇ</cite> <he>וכס׳ הרג וכ׳</he> and he was like thinking (he imagined) that &c., v. <cite ref="E00812"><he>הָרַג</he></cite>; a. fr.—Tanḥ. P’kudé 3 <he>היו סוֹבְרִים וכ׳</he> (perh. to be read: <he>סבורים</he>) they thought that he (Adam) was their creator; <cite ref="Pirkei DeRabbi Eliezer 11:9">Pirké d’R. El. ch. XI</cite> <he>כסבורין</he>.

Koh. R. to X, 10 (ref. to Koh. l. c.) אם נקהה … והוא אינו בא לידך להַסְבִּירוֹ בפניך וכ׳ if thy study has been dull to thee like iron (difficult), and he … does not come to thy side to make it clear before thee, denounce him with all thy might.—Esp. ה׳ פנים to show a bright face; to be friendly; to encourage. Ib. ואין הרב מַסְבִּיר פ׳ לתלמיד and the teacher does not show the pupil a kind face (will not relent); ib. ואין הרב מסביר לתלמיד (sub. פנים). Ib. ואין הקב״ה מסביר פ׳ לדור and the Lord does not look favorably at the generation. Y. Yoma VI, beg. 43ᵇ שלא יהא הדיין מסביר פ׳ … ומעיז וכ׳ that the judge must not be friendly towards the one and severe towards the other (of the litigants).

<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 137:1">Midr. Till. to Ps. CXXXVII</cite> <he>אלהיהן … וכיון שמַסְבִּירִין לו פ׳ וכ׳</he> their God is merciful, and as soon as they show him a kind face, he takes pity &c.; <cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 28">Pesik. R. s. 28</cite>.
Ber. 63ᵇ אני ואתה נַסְבִּיר פ׳ בהלכה let us cheer each other up in the halakhah (by discussion).
<cite ref="Berakhot 63b:7">Ib.</cite> <he>כשם שאני הִסְבַּרְתִּי … הַסְבֵּר פ׳ וכ׳</he> as I have been kind to thee, so be thou kind (forgiving) to &c.; a. fr.
